description: A worldwide legal-aid REFERRAL target — a real public-interest legal-aid body, bar pro-bono program, government consultation window, or court self-help center to which a consenting adherent may be ROUTED for help from licensed human counsel. Types the registry 20-actors/chigiri/registry/legal-aid.seed.json. R0 skeleton (permissive) per ADR-2605262700; activation gated per chigiri R1 triggers. CONSTITUTIONAL boundaries encoded structurally: (G14 UPL) chigiri renders NO legal advice — every entry is a REFERRAL/wayfinding pointer only, never an advice source; the human lawyer / legal-aid org at the target is the practitioner. (G15 zero-compensation) the referral charges the adherent NOTHING — no fee, no nominal processing fee, no tithe attribution, no SBT-priced purchase, no indirect benefit; no consideration property (fee / price / amount / cost / tithe / sbtPrice / paymentRef / chargeable / invoice / billing) is representable at the schema layer, and donations flow only to the general Public Fund and MUST NOT be coupled to a specific referral. (G8 Public-Fund-routed) any onward human-counsel engagement is funded from the Public Fund, never adherent-paid. This registry is an observational, informational MIRROR for civic wayfinding — it is NEVER an official channel and is NOT politically partisan or a campaigning instrument. Every seed entry ships `verificationStatus = unverified-seed`: per G14 NO live routing may occur against an unverified entry, and entries MUST be human/Council-verified and re-checked within the freshness window before any production use. authority / channel / legalBasis / language fields are best-effort public references EXPECTED to drift; confirm at the official source before any use.

referralId.description: Stable slug identifying this referral target (mirrors the seed `referralId`; the record-key concept). MUST be unique within the registry, e.g. 'jp-houterasu-legal-aid' / 'us-lsc-find-legal-aid' / 'de-beratungshilfe-amtsgericht'.

title.description: Human-readable name of the referral target (local + romanized/translated as available), e.g. 'Japan Legal Support Center (日本司法支援センター / 法テラス)'.

jurisdiction.description: ISO jurisdiction (country, country-subdivision, or supranational tag) the target serves, e.g. jpn / usa / deu / fra / gbr / can / aus / ind / sgp / eu-wide.

bloc.description: Coarse grouping for routing/coverage display, e.g. 'jpn-national' / 'usa-state-ca' / 'eu-member-de' / 'ukcw-au'. Observational grouping only, not an official designation.

authority.description: The public-interest body operating the target (legal-aid corporation, bar association, government window, court). Best-effort public reference; EXPECTED to drift.

channel.description: Public wayfinding pointer (official URL, hotline, locator, walk-in window) by which a member reaches the target. Wayfinding scaffold only, NOT an official channel of etzhayyim; EXPECTED to drift (numbers, hours, URLs).

legalBasis.description: Public reference to the statute/regulation/program under which the target operates (informational provenance, e.g. '総合法律支援法 Art. 30' / 'Legal Services Corporation Act of 1974' / 'BerHG'). Best-effort; verify before reliance.

language.description: Primary service/content language of the target (BCP-47-ish short tag, e.g. ja / en / de / fr).

provenance.description: Source URL / citation backing this entry (open-method provenance, G6-style). For verification, not advice.

confidence.description: Seed-author confidence in the accuracy/stability of this entry's wayfinding details. Informational only; does NOT authorize live use — verificationStatus governs that.

lastVerified.description: Timestamp of the most recent human/source check of this entry. Re-check is required within the registry freshness window.

verificationStatus.description: G14 gate — NO live routing may occur against an entry that is not `verified`. Seed entries ship `unverified-seed`; they MUST be human/Council-verified (and re-checked within the freshness window) before any production wayfinding.

notes.description: Free-text caveats: UPL boundary restatement (chigiri renders NO legal advice; referral routing only; zero compensation; Public-Fund-routed), scope/eligibility limits, jurisdiction caveats, and drift warnings. Informational only — MUST NOT contain legal advice.
